activeWork.summary: Looper v0 proves a reusable local capture runtime: supplied count-in/capture timing, browser input permission, one bounded recording, replay/loop/re-record and an improvisation handoff without grading or transcription.

gate.statement: Looper v0 must remain reusable runtime infrastructure rather than exercise-specific theory logic: the supplying exercise/accompaniment layer provides context and capture duration, while the looper owns permission, count-in, local MediaRecorder capture and loop playback only. Require exact-head verify, exact-head Pages preview, Arun browser/physical-guitar/input-device review and explicit approval before merge.
